definitions.explanation: A person employed in an organization, especially in government offices, schools, hospitals, or other public institutions.

examples.japanese: {職員|しょくいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{職員|しょくいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A city hall employee helped me.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧500⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{職員|しょくいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: About 500 staff members work at this hospital.

notes:
Primarily used for employees of public institutions such as government offices, schools, and hospitals. Less commonly used for private-sector employees, where ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ or ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧ are preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職員|しょくいん}{室|しつ}: staff room
- {職員|しょくいん}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: staff meeting
- {職員|しょくいん}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧: staff recruitment
- ⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧{職員|しょくいん}: government employee
- ⟦{常勤|じょうきん}→常勤：16063_joukin⟧{職員|しょくいん}: full-time staff
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{職員|しょくいん}: part-time staff

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: company employee — specifically for private companies
- ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧: employee — broader term, any workplace
- ⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧: civil servant — specifically government workers
- ⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧: staff — loanword, common in service and media industries
